ops.loadingHours: For load-in and load-out of equipment, devices, food and drink, etc., confirm the route and the number of vehicles in a prior meeting and submit a "Work Notice". Protective covering (curing) must always be laid during load-in and load-out, and work may be stopped if the prescribed protective covering is not approved. Packages sent in advance should, in principle, be sent to "TIME24 Building, 2-4-32 Aomi, Koto-ku, Tokyo 135-0064" with arrival specified for 9:00-17:00 on the weekday before the day, with the usage date, venue and event name written on the slip (they are stored in the designated venue until the day of use; depending on the situation, the user may move them on the day). Meeting materials, etc. are in principle brought in on the day. Return shipping of packages after the event can be arranged at the venue; the only carriers that can be arranged are Yamato Transport and Sagawa Express (the pickup date is in principle the day after the usage date). (Meeting Facility Usage Guide revised September 2025 (Reiwa 7), FAQ)
ops.parking: The TIME24 Building parking lot is on B1F, with about 20 spaces for visitors (1 for wheelchair users). Hours are 7:00-21:00 on weekdays (until 19:00 on Sat, Sun and holidays), the fee is 250 yen per 30 minutes, and the height limit is 2.1 m. If you show a disability certificate or similar to the staff, parking for that day is free. The Meeting Facility Usage Guide says whether the parking lot will be used is a matter to be agreed at the time of use.
ops.catering: Food and drink are allowed in the venue. When serving food and drink to attendees, consult the Koto City Public Health Center and, if a notification or similar is required, follow the Health Center's instructions. If you want a party or reception (including catering), consult when making the usage inquiry; the venue fee is 50% above the base rate, and a cleaning fee may be charged. When bringing in food and drink from outside, consult in advance; waste disposal is required. Options Tokyo Big Sight can arrange: boxed meals (Maisen from a minimum of 5,000 yen (tax included), Ningyocho Imahan from a minimum of 7,000 yen (excluding tax), Kaiseki Ryori Aoyama from a minimum of 15,000 yen (excluding tax), Nadaman from a minimum of 15,000 yen (tax included), all up to 7 business days before), catering (CB Service from 30 people, food and drink from 5,500 yen (excluding tax); Tokyo Bay Ariake Washington Hotel from 100 people, from 9,000 yen (excluding tax)), and drinks (Restaurant Seagull, minimum 1,200 yen (tax included), up to 7 business days before).
ops.restaurants: The Sky Restaurant SEAGULL is on the 11th floor (285 seats). In the evening it is a reservation-only party venue that can be used for receptions after meetings and training, and it can host banquets and parties of up to about 200 people. On Sat, Sun and holidays, it can operate by advance reservation with a minimum guarantee of 300,000 yen or more. There is a 7-Eleven on the 1st floor.
